components.label: Codex runtime bridge
components.summary: Owns the embedded Codex app-server bridge, context projection, and Codex-native thread handoff inside OpenClaw.
invariants: OpenClaw assembles context; Codex owns canonical thread state.
Codex prompt projection must treat assembled context as quoted reference, not fresh instructions.
Changes here must preserve Codex-native compaction and transcript mirror behavior.

components.label: Context engine core
components.summary: Defines the context-engine contract, slot selection, bootstrap and compaction lifecycles, and runtime delegation helpers.
invariants: The plugin slot contract is additive and fail-closed when a selected engine is invalid.
Non-legacy engines may inject systemPromptAddition but must still return ordered messages and token estimates.
Context-engine compaction must preserve runtime-owned transcript rotation semantics.

components.label: Embedded PI runner
components.summary: Owns the default OpenClaw model loop, prompt assembly, deferred maintenance, and tool execution lifecycle for non-native runtimes.
invariants: The runner owns prepared prompt assembly and generic tool orchestration for PI-mode turns.
Deferred context-engine maintenance must never silently corrupt transcript lineage.
Compaction and retries must preserve stable runtime context for the active run attempt.

components.label: Plugin control plane
components.summary: Owns plugin manifests, capability registration, slot activation, and runtime/plugin metadata boundaries.
invariants: Extension production code must stay on plugin-sdk seams and its own local package files.
Manifest metadata must remain cheap and accurate without executing plugin runtime code.
Context-engine ids are plugin-owned and must not collide with the reserved core legacy id.
